# Component Catalog

Every exported component in `@neckar-hub/typescript-react-ui`, grouped by functional category.

**Check this catalog before implementing a new frontend component or hardcoding markup.** Search by keyword
(`date`, `select`, `table`, `dialog`, `money`, …) to find an existing component, then import it from the listed path.

Descriptions live as JSDoc on the components; this file is generated from the source — do not edit it directly.

| Component | Description |

| `AdjustableValueSelect` | Select counterpart of [AdjustableValueTextInput]: edits an `AdjustableValue<T>` whose effective value is one of a fixed option list rather than free text. |
| `AdjustableValueTextInput` | Input component for adjustable text values |
| `Checkbox` | Accessible toggle that switches between checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states. |
| `Combobox` | Searchable single-select dropdown with flat (inline) and popover variants, supporting custom item rendering. |
| `DatePicker` | Calendar-day picker for `LocalDate` fields (the rare exception — see ADR 0150). |
| `DateRangePicker` | Calendar-day range picker for `LocalDate` fields (the rare exception — see ADR 0150). |
| `DateTimePicker` | Combined calendar + time-of-day picker — a single popover trigger that opens onto a `Calendar` for the date and a `TimeInput` for the time portion of an `Instant` value. |
| `DurationInput` | MM:SS duration input with increment/decrement buttons, storing the value in milliseconds. |
| `FileInput` | Select a file from the user's device and pass it to the parent component via the onChange callback. |
| `InputWrapper` | Component that wraps any input and renders a border as well as a clear button |
| `NumberInput` | Locale-aware numeric input with optional increment/decrement buttons, unit display, and clear action. |
| `PasswordInput` | Password input with show/hide toggle and clear button. |
| `PhoneNumberInput` | Phone number input that formats the value on blur according to the given country code. |
| `RadioGroup` | Single-selection radio button group; pair with RadioGroupItem for each option. |
| `RangeSlider` | Two-thumb slider for selecting a numeric range between a minimum and maximum value. |
| `Select` | Single-value select with an integrated clear button, wrapping the primitives Select with InputWrapper styling. |
| `SelectedEntityButton` | The button that shows the selected entity and opens its select dialog, inside an `InputWrapper` with the clear X. |
| `SelectFromEnum` | Select dropdown that generates its options automatically from a TypeScript enum, with i18n labels. |
| `SelectFromList` | Select dropdown that binds to a typed object list, using deep equality to match the selected value. |
| `SelectIdFromList` | Select dropdown that binds to the id field of items in a typed list; value and onChange operate on the string id. |
| `SelectPlaceholder` | Disabled select trigger shown while options are loading, with optional error or warning tooltip. |
| `Slider` | Single-thumb slider for selecting one numeric value along a track. |
| `Switch` | Toggle switch for a binary on/off setting, rendered as a sliding thumb control. |
| `TagPicker` | Multi-select popover for picking tags from a list, showing selected tags as removable badges. |
| `Textarea` | Multi-line text input with null-as-empty normalization and optional resize handle. |
| `TextInput` | Single-line text input (text, email, or url) with a clear button and optional left/right add-ons. |
| `TextList` | A list of free texts: one input per entry with a remove button beside it, and an add button below. |
| `TimeInput` | Time-of-day input for an HH:MM (or HH:MM:SS) string value, with an integrated clear button. |
| `ToggleGroup` | Group of connected toggle buttons where one or more items can be pressed simultaneously. |
| `ToggleGroupFromEnum` | Single-select ToggleGroup that generates one item per value of a TypeScript enum automatically, with i18n labels. |

## Domain exports

Barrel modules of one business domain that export several related symbols under a single import path.

### `@neckar-hub/typescript-react-ui/draft-confirmed`

| Export | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `AddressSection` | Detail-page section for a 0..1 embedded address with its own Draft/Confirmed lifecycle: the address with its confirmation status (or a `NoValue` placeholder when absent), the edit action and the confirm action. |
| `CascadingDraftResetWarningDialog` | Warning dialog shown when editing a confirmed entity. |
| `collectFieldErrors` | Flattens a field-keyed validation error record into a flat error list. |
| `ConfirmationStatusBadge` | Badge showing an entity's draft/confirmed confirmation status. |
| `ConfirmEntityDialog` | Confirmation dialog for confirming a draft entity. |
| `FilterByConfirmationStatus` | Filter control for an entity's confirmation status (draft/confirmed). |
| `HasValidationErrors` | HasValidationErrors adds an alert icon and a hover card with validation error details to its children when validation errors are present. |
| `needsEditing` | True when a draft still has unresolved validation errors and should be routed to editing. |
| `ReconfirmAfterSaveWarning` | Displays an info alert warning that all data must be re-confirmed after saving. |
| `useAskCascadingResetDecision` | Shows the `CascadingDraftResetWarningDialog` through `<DialogRegistry />` and answers the decision the user clicks; closing the dialog answers `Cancel`. |
| `useConfirmCascadingReset` | Answers whether a save of `entity` may go ahead: `undefined` (not stored yet) and a Draft save at once, every other status asks the cascading reset warning, because the save turns it and its dependents back into Drafts. |
| `ValidationErrorsHoverContent` | Content for a HoverCard that explains why an entity cannot be confirmed. |
| `ValidationErrorsList` | Renders a list of validation errors with optional links. |

### `@neckar-hub/typescript-react-ui/entities`

| Export | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ArchivedBadge` | Badge marking an entity as archived; renders nothing when the entity is active. |
| `ArchivedEditLockReason` | Why the edit and the save action of an archived record are disabled; its `disabledReason`, beside the `ArchivedEntityBanner`. |
| `ArchivedEntityBanner` | Top-of-page banner shown on detail pages when the entity is archived. |
| `ArchiveScope` | The view switch over an entity's archive state, a scope rather than a filter because archiving is a soft delete: a toggle group with the options only active, only archived and all, of which exactly one is selected. |
| `EntityStatusBadge` | Combined status badge for an entity's archive state and confirmation status. |
| `StatusBadge` | Badge showing one status of an entity as a toned icon, with the label as text in the `with-text` variant and as tooltip in both; `loading` swaps the icon for a spinner while the status changes. |

| Export | Description |
| --- | --- |

| `VersionConflictDialog` | Dialog shown when a save is rejected because somebody else saved the record meanwhile; the user decides whether the stored state or the own input counts. |
